versions.changelog: VGM Loop 1.0. Seamless looping of tagged FLAC, Ogg Vorbis and Opus tracks with Repeat One in the Jellyfin web client (desktop browsers, iPhone, Jellyfin iOS app). Next skips ahead in Repeat One, the repeat mode sticks across queues, and the next loop track is preloaded so it starts without a pause.
The repeat mode you pick for music now sticks: starting another track or album keeps it, and it is remembered across page reloads. Video queues are unaffected.

Next skips to the next track in Repeat One (Repeat One stays on; a track that ends by itself still repeats). Includes all earlier features: seamless loop playback with Repeat One for FLAC, Ogg Vorbis and Opus.

name: VGM Loop
description: Seamless, sample-accurate looping of LOOPSTART/LOOPLENGTH-tagged FLAC, Ogg Vorbis and Opus in the Jellyfin web client, tied to the Repeat One button. No re-encoding.
overview: Seamless tagged-loop playback for video game music
